profile.name: Fajri Rinaldi Chan
profile.headline: Computer Science | Lecturer | Mobile Engineer | Director at Torkata Tech Solution
profile.title: Computer Science
profile.bio: Hello I'm Fajri Rinaldi Chan, I have 4+ years of experience in Flutter mobile development. Currently working as a Lecturer in Informatics and Director at Torkata Tech Solution. Passionate about teaching, technology, and building innovative solutions.

experience.company: UIN Sjech M Djamil Djambek Bukittinggi
experience.description: Lecturer in Informatics with experience in teaching and academic development. Actively involved in delivering several core and advanced courses in the field of computer science. Teaching approach focuses on building strong conceptual understanding while guiding students toward practical implementation through projects, case studies, and applied problem-solving.
Leading Torkata Tech Solution, a technology company focused on providing innovative IT solutions and services.
Managing projects and coordinating development efforts at Garis Kode, ensuring timely delivery and quality outputs.
Developing mobile applications using Flutter framework, implementing clean architecture and best practices.

Content writer focusing on programming and technology topics on the 'Garis Kode' blog platform, providing in-depth information and insights to readers. Presenting detailed and informative articles about programming languages, latest technological concepts, and recent developments in the IT world.

Responsible for providing technical guidance, coordinating development efforts, and leading colleagues in creating innovative and effective technological solutions. Accountable for designing system architecture, making intelligent technical decisions, ensuring high-quality code, and ensuring that projects run according to schedule and budget.
highlights: Building the Orbit management and administration information system using Flutter for Mobile Application
Using Codeigniter4 framework for Frontend Web and NodeJS for Backend
Building a web landing page and news website
Creating an artificial intelligence robot named 'TEROBIK'

publications.title: Transformasi Digital: Peluang Bisnis TI di Era Society 5.0
publications.description: Buku bahan ajar yang membekali pembaca dengan pemahaman mendalam mengenai gelombang transformasi digital dalam konteks visi Society 5.0. Disusun secara sistematis mulai dari konsep dasar, perkembangan Society 5.0, pemanfaatan teknologi kunci, inovasi model bisnis digital hingga strategi sukses, tantangan dan etika bisnis digital.

publications.title: Pemrograman Dasar Python Web Menggunakan Framework Django Untuk Pemula
publications.description: Buku ini ditujukan untuk pemula yang ingin mempelajari dasar-dasar pemrograman dengan menggunakan bahasa pemrograman Python dan database MySQL. Memberikan pengantar yang komprehensif dan langkah-demi-langkah dalam mempelajari Python, Django framework, dan MySQL database.
